verdict.rationale: Alma publishes both its own preparation timeline (~2 weeks once evidence is collected, described as guaranteed, and ~31 business days on the O-1A page) and the government processing times it depends on (15 business days for premium processing, 4–6 months for USCIS). This side-by-side breakdown is documented for the O-1A, and the EB-1 guide mentions wait time. Missing for 10: equivalent published provider and government timeline breakdowns for the other visa types (H-1B, EB-2 NIW, TN, E-2), reconciliation of the ~31 business days versus ~2 weeks figures, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these timelines are met.
